claim.summary: For idempotents u,v in a commutative F2 algebra, the standard two-term multiplication-by-u Koszul complex retracts onto (1-u)B in both degrees with h=m_u. Changing the differential to m_v gives delta h=m_(u(1-v)) on degree zero, an idempotent. Thus smallness holds iff u(1-v)=0; then the transferred differential is m_(v(1-u)). Complete singleton ENS input changes x to y realize failure, whereas changing x to x OR y gives smallness with nonzero effective differential. Constant r=1 normalizes these easy sources.
